title: Independent reading: Luke 4:16–21
subtitle: Read scripture, quotation, and fulfillment claim in sequence.
overview: Luke 4 combines narrated action, Scripture reading, and Jesus’ interpretive declaration. Label each voice and quotation boundary.
The final perfect passive form establishes the claim’s relation to the Scripture quotation; do not separate it from the preceding reading.

items.grc: πνεῦμα κυρίου ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ, οὗ εἵνεκεν ἔχρισέν με.
items.en: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he anointed me.

items.grc: σήμερον πεπλήρωται ἡ γραφὴ αὕτη ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν ὑμῶν.
items.en: Today this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.
